title: Product lifecycle
summary: Connect market learning, product decisions, delivery, support, and continued improvement.

stages.purpose: Understand users, needs, alternatives, and opportunity.
Test whether the opportunity and proposed value merit investment.
Choose outcomes, requirements, scope, story map, and acceptance evidence.
Shape product, service, and technical choices and risks.
Order work and confirm readiness, ownership, and verification.
Build, verify, accept, and release the product change.
outputs: JUnit or platform-native test report uploaded when supported

stages.purpose: Operate the service and support users.
Measure outcomes, improve, or retire responsibly.

statusAuthority: Use the consumer's configured tracker or ask the user. This definition does not store work status.
